prompt: How many times in the history of the Summer Olympic Games has the United States not topped the medal table?
answer:
The United States **did not top the Summer Olympic medal table 11 times** out of the 30 Summer Olympics held through 2024.

That includes **1980**, when the U.S. boycotted the Moscow Games. Counting only Olympics in which the U.S. competed, it failed to finish first **10 times**.
